selection_rule: all E5 V1.2 P-CORE rows with mechanism=mixed; no filtering by which single-family restoration succeeded
restoration_rule: restore every information family named in the cell frozen mixed_recipe simultaneously; no other family changes
what_it_tests: Whether the two frozen latent-information families jointly explain residual ambiguity in mixed-mechanism cells after single-family restoration.
expected_if_compositional: P+PAIR should collapse ambiguity more often than either single-family restoration, while failures remain reportable.
claim_boundary: Post-E5 supplementary mechanistic evidence only. Outcome-informed selection prevents treating E5B as preregistered confirmatory evidence.
